title: Assist
summary: ASSIST', verb transitive [Latin assisto, of ad and sisto, to stand up; English, to stand by.] To help; to aid; to succor; to give support to in some undertaking or effort, or in time of distress. ASSI

inlines.v: ASSIST', verb transitive [Latin assisto, of ad and sisto, to stand up; English, to stand by.] To help; to aid; to succor; to give support to in some undertaking or effort, or in time of distress. ASSIST', verb intransitive To lend aid.
